title: Happy Trails
summary: Some of the best of early psychedlic rock. When folks wanted that harder edge they heard from Hendrix and Cream you turned to Quicksilver Messenger Service first. It was Quicksilver, the Dead, and Jefferson Airplane. Together they reshaped music. John Cipollina deserves a spot on best rock guitarists ever but few know his name.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wi0e7brHdMQ

Some of the best of early psychedlic rock. When folks wanted that harder edge they heard from Hendrix and Cream you turned to Quicksilver Messenger Service first.

It was Quicksilver, the Dead, and Jefferson Airplane. Together they reshaped music.

John Cipollina deserves a spot on best rock guitarists ever but few know his name.
